7,494 likes, 102 comments - peterattiamd on September 10, 2026: "Exercise for preserving cognitive function | Peter Attia, M.D.

This clip is from “Ask Me Anything” episode # 60 (Ep. # 306) of The Drive which was released on 6/17/24.

In the full episode, we cover:

-The relationship between lipids, CVD, and Alzheimer’s disease, and whether statins can increase the risk of neurodegenerative disorders and AD
-How to identify the most impactful and easiest-to-implement ways to improve your health
-Why supplements should be considered as supportive aids rather than primary solutions in one’s strategy to improve longevity
-The relationship between lipids, CVD, and Alzheimer’s disease, and whether statins can increase the risk of neurodegenerative disorders and AD
-Much more

This AMA episode (Ep. # 306) is available exclusively for premium members. Become a member now to watch or listen on my website or your favorite podcast player.".
